Operations.Value: The Blight is a living, adaptive corruption that can change its rhythm or frequency to overwhelm containment mechanisms.
The western channel network contains a 'hydraulic throat,' a constriction point where the Blight accelerates and generates heat/friction that weakens the seal from the inside.
The map's tick marks along the western channel indicate pressure changes and structural constrictions rather than just flow direction.
A secondary channel branches off the main western artery just before the throat, leading to a collapsed section marked by a jagged line on the map.
The barrier's consumption rate can be synchronized with the Blight's arrival rate by matching the quartz stone's frequency to the flow's frequency.
Kaelen's brass gauntlet can detect the frequency of the Blight flow.
The quartz stone previously glowed with aggressive, pulsing light; it now radiates a steady, cool pale blue-white luminescence.
The barrier previously functioned as a containment trap; it is now being prepared to function as a weapon for controlled consumption/striking.
Kaelen's dark veins previously webbed across his neck and forearms; they have receded to faint, bruised lines beneath the skin.
The Blight is flowing west through the channels toward the forest.
The Blight is accelerating and growing in volume.
The Blight is estimated to reach the forest in days or less.
The hydraulic throat is located approximately one mile underground from the forest edge.
Elias Thorne exists and is an established character.
Elias Thorne has identified the 'hydraulic throat' as the strategic fulcrum for the plan.
Elias Thorne has assigned himself the role of navigator, responsible for reading the map and directing the group's actions.
Elias Thorne possesses a bronze map that shows pressure indicators (tick marks) and a secondary spillway channel.
Kaelen is currently unconscious and stable but fragile.
Kaelen's skin has regained opacity but remains thin and translucent.
Kaelen has sustained permanent or semi-permanent faint, bruised vein lines on his neck and forearms.
Kaelen is capable of detecting the frequency of the Blight flow via his gauntlet/resonance.
Kaelen is described as a limited resource whose repeated use risks dissolution.
Maren has assigned herself the role of maintaining Kaelen's physical stability and sealing any essence leaks.
Maren possesses healing magic that leaves residual magic on her skin.
Torin exists and is an established character.
Torin possesses a sword.
Torin is described as a builder who understands load-bearing structures and stress fractures.
Elara exists and is an established character.
Elara has analytical skills in reading star charts and structural blueprints.
Elara has assigned herself the role of leading the group through the forest terrain and preparing/tuning the quartz stone.
The group has formulated a plan to intercept the Blight at the hydraulic throat using a synchronized barrier strike rather than containment.
The group has decided to move immediately to the forest to reach the throat.
The group has assigned specific roles: Elias (navigator), Torin (physical anchor/mind guard), Maren (physical healer/body guard), Elara (terrain leader/quartz tuner), Kaelen (sensor/conduit).
Whether Kaelen can survive the strain of the planned resonance synchronization is not established.

Operations.OldValue: Kaelen entered the temple hall and disappeared into the darkness.
